title: Git Namespaces — Forge Account Link Status — payload
description: A member asks where a forge account link they began stands.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Forge Account Link Status — response payload

state.description: `pending` — waiting for the member to authorise. `linked` — the account is bound to the member's DID. `expired` — not authorised in time. `failed` — the forge refused, or the account is already linked to another member.

account.description: The linked account. Present only when `state` is `linked`.
